Arrow Electronics
provides concept-to-clinic engineering, component sourcing, and supply chain solutions for original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) building medical and consumer health wearables
, including continuous glucose monitors, smartwatches, wearable ECGs, sleep trackers, and remote patient monitoring (RPM) systems.
Arrow Electronics
Engineering and Design Support
Sensor and Power Integration:
Sourcing ultra-low-power microcontrollers, analog front-ends (AFEs), and biometrics sensors (PPG, ECG).
Connectivity and IoT:
Integrating Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE), Wi-Fi, and cellular IoT modules for seamless data transmission.
Edge Intelligence:
Incorporating AI-enabled edge platforms for real-time diagnostic analysis directly on the device.
Prototyping & Testing:
Hardware/software co-design, prototyping, and regulatory compliance navigation through engineering support teams like eInfochips.
Arrow Electronics
Supply Chain and Manufacturing
Component Sourcing:
Lifecycle management and bill-of-materials (BOM) optimization for specialized medical-grade and consumer electronic components.
Resilience Strategies:
Inventory forecasting, buffering, and logistics scaling.
